attributes.name: Scorizscar
attributes.powers:
Scorizscar is immune to the Acid, Mental, and Poison traits. If your check has the Fire trait, add 1d8.

Before you act, each character at your location must attempt a Dexterity or Acrobatics 9 check. Characters who succeed are dealt 2 Acid damage; characters who fail are dealt 1d4+1 Acid damage.
